Product name: BoomGo Bluetooth Speaker
Features: 10-hour battery life, water resistant, dual phone connection
text: BoomGo Bluetooth Speaker delivers 10 hours of continuous playback on a single charge, so your music follows you through your day without interruption. Its water-resistant design handles splashes and moisture, making it suitable for kitchens, bathrooms, and outdoor settings. Dual phone connection lets you pair two devices at once, switching between them seamlessly. Whether you're streaming at home or on the move, this speaker keeps up with your listening without constant recharging or worry about weather.

Product name: BoomGo Bluetooth Speaker
Features: 10-hour battery life, water resistant, dual phone connection
text: Meet BoomGo, your portable speaker that keeps the music going for up to 10 hours straight. Water resistant design means you can take it anywhere—poolside, bathroom, camping trips, no stress. Connect two phones at once, so you and a friend can take turns dropping tracks without the hassle of disconnecting and reconnecting. Just charge it up, pair your devices, and let it handle the soundtrack to your day. Compact enough to slip into a backpack, tough enough to handle whatever you throw at it.
